info.title: ARTEMIS AR/VR Services API
info.description:
REST API for immersive, multi-user collaborative annotation of cultural heritage
3D digital twins, developed by ATHENA Research Center within ARTEMIS WP9.2.

This specification covers the **24 endpoints** of the four AR/VR collaboration
service categories defined in Deliverable D9.2, Section 3.3:

- **Annotations** (7) — six annotation types: POI, LASSO, PRIMITIVE, MEASUREMENT, ENTITY, IMAGE
- **Annotation Groups** (8) — grouping, membership management and export
- **Workspaces** (7) — the collaborative session container, one per 3D asset
- **Save Logs** (2) — append-only audit trail of save events

## Out of scope

Authentication and asset management are, per D9.2 §3.3.1, provided by supporting
infrastructure and are not specified here. Every endpoint below nevertheless
requires a valid JWT Bearer token; integration with the project INDIGO-IAM OIDC
provider is planned.

The active-workspace runtime endpoints are also excluded from this first
publication: they are backed by an in-memory registry whose state does not
survive a restart and would diverge across replicas.

## Persistence model

The API is not real-time. The AR client builds annotations locally and commits
them when the composer saves, as N+1 REST calls ending in a save-log entry.

Primary consumer: the VAX Annotator Unity/AR client on Meta Quest headsets.

servers.description: ARTEMIS Development Platform (CNR-INO, reachable over the project VPN only)

tags.name: Annotations
tags.description: VR annotation creation, querying, and export

Point.description: Wraps a Vector3 position. Used inside lasso.points[] and measurement.points[].

Creator.description: Populated creator/composer info embedded in entity responses (AN-2, AG-1, W-1).

SaveLog.description: Immutable audit entry recording a save event on a workspace (SL-1..SL-7).

memberCount.description: Number of annotations in this group (added by some endpoints).

Annotation.description: Unified annotation document. Common fields live at the top level. Exactly one of {poi, lasso, primitive, measurement, entity, image} is populated based on `annotationType`.

PoiData.description: Type-specific data for POI (Point Of Interest) annotations.

LassoData.description: Type-specific data for LASSO annotations. `surface` and `metricUnit` are client-computed.

MeasurementData.description: Type-specific data for MEASUREMENT annotations. `distance` and `metricUnit` are client-computed.

PrimitiveData.description: Type-specific data for PRIMITIVE (3D shape) annotations. `shape` is a free string (G-7).

EntityData.description: Type-specific data for ENTITY (3D model) annotations. `type` is a free string (G-7).

ImageData.description: Type-specific data for IMAGE annotations. `scale` is a single number (uniform scale, IM-3).

title.description: Must be unique among active workspaces (case-insensitive).

accessCode.description: Optional. Empty string for public workspace. Will be uppercased server-side.

UpdateWorkspaceRequest.description: Partial update — all fields optional. `assetId` and `composerId` are immutable.

accessCode.description: Empty string clears the code (public workspace).

createdBy.description: Optional userId of the actual creator. Falls back to JWT user if omitted (G-2 async).

annotationIds.description: Optional array of annotation IDs to add to the group on creation.

UpdateAnnotationGroupRequest.description: Partial update. Two tiers — title/description require composer role; visibility is open to any authenticated user (AG-6).

CreateAnnotationRequest.description: Create an annotation. The body should include the appropriate nested sub-object (poi/lasso/primitive/measurement/entity/image) matching `annotationType`. Schema is permissive (AN-10) — completeness is validated by POST /artemis/annotations/validate.

createdBy.description: Optional userId of the actual creator. Falls back to JWT user if omitted.

UpdateAnnotationRequest.description: Partial update. `createdBy` is ignored (AN-11). Type-specific sub-object is merged.

post.description: Create a new annotation group within a workspace. Optionally add initial annotations on creation and set visibility. Any authenticated user can create groups. The `createdBy` field is optional in body (G-2 async) — falls back to the authenticated JWT user if omitted.

memberCount.description: Number of annotations added to group

400.description: Validation error (empty title, title too long, archived workspace, or annotations not in same workspace)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Workspace not found or one or more annotations not found

get.description: List annotation groups with optional filtering by workspace. Returns groups sorted by creation date (newest first) with populated creator information.

200.description: List of annotation groups retrieved successfully

memberCount.description: Number of annotations in this group (always present on this endpoint).

workspace.description: Populated subset of the parent workspace.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieve a specific annotation group by its MongoDB ObjectId. Optionally include all member annotations in the response using the includeMembers query parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation group

members.description: Array of member annotations (only if includeMembers=true)

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

put.description: Update an annotation group's metadata. Two authorization tiers: (1) `title` / `description` updates require the caller to have composer role. (2) `visibility` updates are permitted for any authenticated user — it's a client-controlled UI setting (AG-6). Attempts to update `createdBy` are ignored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation group

400.description: Validation error (empty title, title too long, or archived workspace)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have composer role

delete.description: Permanently delete an annotation group. Only users with composer role can delete. Member annotations remain in the workspace but are removed from the group (annotationGroupId set to null). This is a hard delete.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation group

ungroupedCount.description: Number of member annotations whose annotationGroupId was reset to null

400.description: Workspace is archived (read-only)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have composer role

post.description: Add one or more annotations to an annotation group. Annotations are automatically removed from their previous group if they belong to one. Validates that all annotations belong to the same workspace as the group.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation group

annotationIds.description: Array of annotation IDs to add to the group

addedCount.description: Annotations newly added (excludes those already in the group).

movedCount.description: Annotations transferred from a different group.

skippedCount.description: Annotations that were already members of this group.

group.description: Updated group metadata after the operation.

400.description: Validation error (empty array, annotations from different workspace, archived workspace, etc.)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Annotation group or annotation not found

delete.description: Remove a specific annotation from an annotation group by setting its annotationGroupId to null. The annotation remains in the workspace. Any authenticated user can remove annotations from groups.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation group

parameters.name: annotationId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation to remove

400.description: Annotation does not belong to this group

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Annotation group or annotation not found

get.description: Export an annotation group with all its member annotations as JSON. Includes group metadata, workspace information, and all annotations sorted by creation date. Useful for backup and data integration.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the annotation group

annotations.description: All member annotations in the group

exportedAt.description: Timestamp of when export was created

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a new annotation in a workspace. Supports 6 types (POI, LASSO, PRIMITIVE, MEASUREMENT, ENTITY, IMAGE). Type-specific fields live in a nested sub-object named after the type (`poi`, `lasso`, `primitive`, `measurement`, `entity`, `image`). The `createdBy` field is optional in body (G-2 async entity rule) — falls back to the authenticated JWT user if omitted. The schema is permissive; per-type completeness is enforced by the `/validate` endpoint (AN-10).

400.description: Validation error (missing required fields, invalid createdBy, etc.)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Workspace or annotation group not found

get.description: List annotations with filtering by workspace, type, group, or creator; supports sorting, pagination, and field selection.

count.description: Number of annotations in this page

total.description: Total matching the filter (across all pages)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Validate an annotation's completeness for its type without creating a DB record. Supports two modes: (1) Pre-persistence — send the full annotation body. (2) Post-persistence — send `{ _id: "..." }` and the endpoint fetches and validates. Returns `{ valid, errors[], warnings[] }`. Per-type rules are defined in AN-10 / LA-5 / ME-5 / EN-2 / IM-4.

oneOf.description: Post-persistence mode — fetch and validate by id.

400.description: Invalid _id format or missing annotationType

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Annotation (_id) not found in post-persistence mode

get.description: Export annotations with metadata. Requires workspaceId. No pagination — returns all matching annotations.

400.description: Missing workspaceId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieve a specific annotation by its MongoDB ObjectId.

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

put.description: Update an existing annotation's fields. Only composers can update. `createdBy` in body is intentionally ignored (AN-11) — the creator never changes. `annotationType` cannot be changed after creation. Type-specific sub-objects (`poi`, `lasso`, `primitive`, `measurement`, `entity`, `image`) are merged, so partial updates are allowed.

400.description: Validation error (empty title, invalid annotationGroupId, archived workspace, etc.)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden — user is not a composer

404.description: Annotation or annotation group not found

delete.description: Permanently delete an annotation. Only composers can delete. Hard delete — no soft-delete flag.

400.description: Workspace is archived (read-only)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden — user is not a composer

post.summary: Create a save log entry for a workspace
post.description: Records an incremental summary describing what happened during the most recent save session of a workspace. Immutable audit entry — no update or delete endpoints exist. Any authenticated user can create a save log (authorization is trust-based at the AR client layer — only the workspace composer has access to the Save UI). See DESIGN_DECISIONS SL-1..SL-7.

workspaceId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the workspace this save log belongs to

summary.description: User-written summary of what happened in the session (1-2000 chars)
summary.example: Added 3 POI annotations near the north wall, deleted 1 outdated measurement.

400.description: Validation error (missing/empty fields, summary too long, invalid workspaceId format, archived workspace)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.summary: List save logs for a workspace
get.description: Returns all save log entries for a given workspace, sorted newest first.

400.description: Missing or invalid workspaceId query parameter

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a VR collaboration workspace with optional access code and linked asset. Only users with 'composer' role can create workspaces. Workspace titles must be unique among active workspaces.

400.description: Validation error (missing fields, title not unique, title too long)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have 'composer' role

get.description:
List workspaces filtered by user role:
  * **composer-role users** see ONLY workspaces they created.
  * **viewer-role users** see ALL workspaces matching the status filter.

Defaults to `status=active` if no query param is provided. Each workspace in the response has its `assetId` populated as a nested `asset: { id, title, description, resourceURL }` and its `composerId` populated as a nested `composer: { id, name }`.

asset.description: Populated subset of the linked asset.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific workspace by its ID, including asset and composer details

asset.description: Populated subset of the linked asset.

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

put.description: Update workspace metadata (title, description, accessCode). All fields are optional. Only the workspace creator can update. Title must be unique among active workspaces if changed.

400.description: Validation error (empty title, title too long, title not unique)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - user is not the workspace creator

404.description: Workspace not found (invalid id or no document with that id)

delete.description: Soft delete workspace by setting status to 'archived'. The workspace is not permanently deleted and can be viewed with status=archived query. Only the workspace creator can archive.

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - user is not the workspace creator

get.description: Retrieve all annotations in a workspace with optional filtering by annotation type. Returns annotations sorted by creation date (newest first) with populated creator and group information.

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieve all annotation groups in a workspace. Returns groups sorted by creation date (newest first) with populated creator information.

400.description: Invalid ID format - must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token
